name: Demand Satisfaction
description:
Roll Courtesy vs Courtesy against a creature that can see and hear you.

On a win, the creature's attacks against creatures other than you are ill-favored for the next round. If you make an attack against any creature other than the target, the attack roll is ill-favored and this effect ends.

On a loss, check a Condition.

Describe how you challenge your opponent.
successes:
✨: On a win, the effect lasts for 3 rounds.

🌞: On a win, the effect lasts for one minute.
